images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A narrative game where the player is a street vending machine. Three-quarter side view of a narrow back alley on a rainy night: on the left a tall crimson Korean drink vending machine glows cold white-cyan, three rows of colorful cans behind rain-speckled glass, the bottom row marked as hot drinks with a warm orange band, a red LED coin display reading '0700'. A tired night-shift nurse in teal scrubs and a long grey cardigan holds a clear plastic umbrella and reaches toward the coin slot, her edge rim-lit cyan by the machine. Wet asphalt reflects the machine as blurred red and white streaks; a sodium streetlamp glows amber deep in the alley. On the right, a dark brushed-metal 'button panel' UI: a customer card '야근 간호사', a monologue box in serif text, six physical drink buttons with stock counts and green/red LEDs, a highlighted warm button '보리차', and an amber action '몰래 한 캔 떨어뜨리기' with an owner-suspicion meter '주인의 의심 42%'. Top-left title '자판기의 마음'. Stylized painterly 2D illustration, deep navy and violet night, cyan machine light versus warm sodium amber, diagonal rain streaks, film grain, soft vignette. Correction: no real beverage brands or logos anywhere (no Coca-Cola, Monster, 칠성사이다, 포카리스웨트, Hi-C, etc.); cans and the six buttons use only generic fictional drink names such as '보리차', '코코아', '유자차', '옥수수수염차', '사이다', '캔커피' with plain invented label art.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Same narrative vending-machine game, 3:47 a.m., heavier rain. Front view, the crimson vending machine fills the center, most of its lights dimmed to a sepia glow except one hot cocoa can in the bottom row outlined in pulsing warm amber. A small cocoa can has just dropped into the take-out tray, lit orange from within, with a hand-drawn onomatopoeia '덜컹.' beside it. A runaway child in a wet brown hoodie with a purple backpack sits hugging their knees against the machine's side, looking up; a quiet line '…이거, 누가 넣은 거예요?'. Background: a closed corner-store metal shutter and brick wall in deep blue darkness. UI: a red warning card top-right '주인의 의심 91%' with a nearly full bar, a yellow sticky note in handwriting from the owner about missing stock, a bottom-left log '오늘 밤의 대답' listing the night's customers with small tags, and two choice cards bottom-right.
